parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The configuration ID. You can call the ListHttpIncomingResponseHeaderModificationRules operation to obtain the configuration ID.

parameters.name: ResponseHeaderModification
parameters.description: The response header modifications. Three operation types are supported: add, delete, and modify.

sub_parameters.name: Operation
sub_parameters.description:
The operation type. Valid values:

- add: Add.
- del: Delete.
- modify: Modify.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The value type. Valid values:
- static: Static pattern.
- dynamic: Dynamic schema.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. Valid values:

- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
